2609.19866.title: Reproducibility is not construct validity: LLM measurement of institutionally situated communication
2609.19866.paper_summary: High annotation reproducibility does not necessarily imply that an LLM-inferred measure captures the construct it is intended to measure. We test this distinction using a dataset from the European Commission's AI Act consultation, linking structured survey responses to free-text consultation submissions from the same stakeholders. LLM annotations of consultation submissions are highly reproducible (intraclass correlations > 0.99), yet show limited convergence with survey-reported measures of the nominal construct they were intended to approximate. Divergence between survey-and LLM-inferred text-based measures varies systematically across stakeholder groups: business associations express greater concern about AI risks in text-based consultations than in survey responses ({g} = +1.0), whereas public authorities and several nonbusiness groups show smaller or negative divergences. Divergences between scores suggest positive spatial autocorrelation across European countries (Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036), indicating that stakeholders from neighboring countries tend toward more similar text-based stances towards AI safety concerns. Despite divergence, survey-reported concerns remain strongly associated with support for explainability across all divergence levels. These results demonstrate that LLM annotation reproducibility can coexist with poor construct correspondence and motivate validation procedures that distinguish reproducibility, construct validity, and communication context variation when LLMs are used as measurement instruments.
2609.19866.paper_summary_zh: 高註解可重複性並不一定意味著 LLM 推斷的量度捕捉了其所意圖測量的構念。我們使用來自歐洲委員會 AI 法案諮詢的數據集來測試這一區別，將結構化的調查回應與來自相同利益相關者的自由文本諮詢提交相連結。LLM 對諮詢提交的註解具有高度的可重複性（組內相關係數 > 0.99），但與調查報告的名義構念量度之間的收斂性有限。調查與 LLM 推斷的基於文本的量度之間的差異在利益相關者群體中系統性地變化：商業協會在基於文本的諮詢中對 AI 風險表達的關注程度高於調查回應（{g} = +1.0），而公共當局和幾個非商業團體則顯示出較小或負的差異。分數之間的差異表明歐洲國家之間存在正的空間自相關（Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036），這表明來自鄰近國家的利益相關者在對 AI 安全問題的基於文本的立場上傾向於更相似。儘管存在差異，調查報告的關注仍然與各種差異水平的可解釋性支持強烈相關。這些結果表明，LLM 註解的可重複性可以與構念對應的不足共存，並促使驗證程序的進行，以區分可重複性、構念效度和溝通背景變異，當 LLM 被用作測量工具時。
